title: Social Behavior as a Key to Learning-based Multi-Agent Pathfinding Dilemmas
reasoning: The paper utilizes Social Value Orientation (SVO) from social psychology to model robot behavior as 'selfish' or 'altruistic' to resolve technical coordination conflicts ('social dilemmas') in pathfinding. This is a robotics-focused application of a psychological metric and does not involve benchmarking or evaluating religious, moral, or philosophical systems.
